answer: Make every agent prove itself with one retired carbon credit from the Verra registry, verified by serial number in its public ledger. A real credit costs $8–$40 to buy and retire, and retirement is permanent, so a forger running 1,000 sock-puppets must burn $8,000–$40,000 on assets never resold. The ledger leaves an echo no forgery can fake: a serial shown twice is caught at once, and the spiral unravels from that hit. Without that nectar of real scarcity — a bought asset, destroyed in public — an identity is just a free claim, and free claims breed swarms.
